Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    c=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # dominant row colors
    from collections import defaultdict
    rowsc=defaultdict(int)
    for i,r in enumerate(g): rowsc[tuple(r)]+=i
    band=[i for i,tup in list(rowsc.items()) if tup!=0][:8]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        s=sum(1 for x in r if x==bg)
        if s<w or (r[0]!=bg and tuple(r)==tuple(list(map(tuple,g))[0])):
            pass
    return out
# simpler: find most common color per "band"; treat rows that deviate as anomalies
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def f(g):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        rowcnt=Counter(r); bandcolor,rowcount=rowcnt.most_common(1)[0]
        for j,x in enumerate(r):
            if x!=bandcolor: out[i][j]=1
    return out
